types: src/server/registration-types.ts is owned only by the main agent. ServerProject in project-store.ts gains tracking:boolean; all existing records default true.

api.POST /api/projects/preview: {name,path} -> ProjectPreview. Authenticated active session; folder access checked before reading any project content. Invalid prepared content returns a preview with canRegister=false and issues. Unauthorized paths return generic 403 without other project names/paths.
api.POST /api/projects: {name,path} -> ServerProject (201). Actor ID comes only from session. Never accept actor/user ID from request. Current account, folder grants, real paths and root collisions checked again. Project and DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS membership created in one SQLite transaction. No membership is needed for local trusted CLI register without actor.
api.GET /api/projects/registration: ProjectRegistrationAccess {allowed,areas}; own areas only; admin allowed=true.
api.GET /api/projects: Existing [{id,name}], only tracking projects visible to current user.
api.POST /api/admin/folder-areas: {userId,path} -> FolderArea; upsert exact existing own area, reject inter-user overlaps
api.GET /api/admin/projects: ServerProject[] includes untracked projects for admin management
api.PUT /api/admin/projects/:id/tracking: {tracking:boolean} -> ServerProject; true revalidates prepared folder and all boundaries, false never touches source files; preserves identity/memberships

errors: Existing {error:string} and session/Origin/CSRF rules. 400 malformed/unprepared input; 401 expired session; 403 unauthorized folder/admin operation; 404 hidden/missing/untracked project on normal routes; 409 project/area overlap; 503 authorized project files unavailable. Never disclose foreign paths/names in ordinary-user errors or preview issues.
folderMeaning: Canonical existing directory, inclusive descendant access, registered per user in central SQLite. Different owners cannot have equal/nested areas. Revoking a folder area revokes future registration only. Changed symlink aliases do not move an area. Admin uses service-account filesystem access; all actual project content must still remain inside project root.

storeInterfaces.AuthStore: listFolderAreas(userId?:string):FolderArea[]; upsertFolderArea(userId,path,beforeCommit?):Promise<FolderArea>; removeFolderArea(id,beforeCommit?):void. Guard runs inside write transaction; auth reads accept v2/v3, permissions rejects untracked.
storeInterfaces.folder-areas.ts: assertRegistrationAccess(database:Database,userId:string,rootPath:string):void (sync, current account/area inside caller's transaction, AuthStoreError with generic message); containsPath(root,path):boolean and pathsOverlap(a,b):boolean reused for real path rules. CLI without actor is trusted admin.
storeInterfaces.ProjectStore: preview(name,path,actorId?):Promise<ProjectPreview>; register(name,path,actorId?,beforeCommit?):Promise<ServerProject>; setTracking(id,tracking,beforeCommit?):Promise<ServerProject>; list/load include tracked and untracked. Collision checked before reading source; ordinary actor receives no existing project metadata.
storeInterfaces.project-paths.ts: assertProjectBoundary(rootPath:string):void synchronous runtime guard usable before every cached/API/WS access. Ensure config candidates, resolved Backlog directories, record files and attachments cannot escape, including changed links. Binding agent owns BacklogServer safety guards if required and reports needed central hooks to main.

schema: Areas agent exclusively owns additive v3 migration: projects.tracking INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(tracking IN(0,1)); folder_areas canonical id/user_id/root_path/created_at. Recognize old project-only v0 and auth v2 exactly; create/upgrade only in successful write transaction. Preserve all existing data and reject lookalike/broken schemas.

binding: src/server/project-paths.ts and project inspection helper if needed
src/core/content-store.ts (existing watcher reads use shared reader)
ui: other UI DOM tests only as needed

workflow: Use source CLI bun run cli for task reads/plans/notes, assign your stated @codex-* name and activate your own task. Never directly edit Backlog markdown. No agent spawns further agents, switches branch, commits or reverts others. Ask main for shared-file changes. Each agent runs scoped meaningful tests, simplifies, records evidence, then independently reviews another area when main requests. Main runs full final checks, actual Chromium, finalization, handoff, commit/push.
boundaries: Only ready projects, no init/create/migration of source Backlog. No history/A-04/agent mode/A-05. Existing A-02 defaults and session/draft behavior retained. No descriptive copy beneath headings unless required to prevent an error. Groma command unavailable at start; no owned files edited.
sharedCodeRequirement: A-03 requires every configuration/record/attachment read to remain inside the project root, including changed links and caches/watchers. Optional central opened-file reader is injected into existing FileSystem, Core, ContentStore/config watcher and config discovery. Existing parsers, record CRUD, search and board implementations remain canonical; no alternative content surface is introduced. Existing local filesystem/cache/config/discovery/task-corpus/API tests preserve normal behavior.
